selection_rule: All complete rejected candidates whose selection VAL F1 OR CV F1 exceeds trial_001; frozen before inspecting candidate TEST outcomes.

metrics.metric_scope: Local device F1 with frozen task lead interval. Alarmed fault with no in-window hit counts FP and FN. Unknown follow-up excluded and reported separately.

baseline_report.note: Frozen selected model replay on reserved TEST dates; historical project use of these dates prevents a claim of a fresh independent blind test. Outcomes must not be used to retune or select another model.
